# Responsive Portfolio (HTML + CSS + JS)

## Run (Node.js)
Open a terminal in this folder (`portfolio/`) and run:

```bash
node server.js
```

Then open `http://localhost:5173`

## Customize
- `index.html`: your name, links, projects, contact email
- `assets/css/styles.css`: colors, layout, spacing
- `assets/js/main.js`: theme toggle, mobile menu, contact form behavior
